- runtime_release_contract rebinds to the new proof authority: review 6114935703, coordinator e3a54b3d, contract 2bafa409. The live image (bac52) and historical receipt (ac4ffc39) now come from proof_contract constants. HISTORICAL_ROOT_PATH points at the 171dd36c release root.
- validate_proof, verify_gate and frozen_files require candidate_identity, meaning both ordered parents, the union tree and the PR tree. They also require naturalIntakePolicy and manifest head == f830f900.
- formal_pr_review and the collector are retargeted from #292 to #291, and the collector now runs validate_merge_identity.
- source_review_pass now binds the build, prepare and launch hashes through authority_hashes.
- The kit-review exclusions now also refuse the old kit pass 6114626674 and this proof-source PASS.
- The deploy still refuses unless the running writer is the bac52 image and the ac4ffc39 receipt is unchanged. The only other deploy change is a log label.
- New tests confirm that #292, a reversed parent order, a swapped tree, a REWIND cursor policy, the old ae64 base and head==base are all refused.
- Tests run from the extraction:
  - 138 tests ran in total.
  - 137 pass.
  - The one exception is test_old_guard_and_verifier_bytes_stay_exact, which needs `git show HEAD:` and so cannot run outside Pip's harness. I verified those guard and verifier hashes directly instead.

Scope: this PASS covers the packaging source only. It does not authorise a proof, a kit, a gate or any live action. Kit freeze requires a stopped PASSED proof on f830f900 (only after main CI 38182451105 is green), followed by a NEW exact-kit "Audit passed" on the frozen manifest. Production stays on 171dd36c/bac52 until then. All forward-only and no-touch rules are unchanged.
